items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability, actively exploited in the wild, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (VULN-39341) for this flaw, rated with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (September 2026)
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying this isolated patch in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (August 2026)
items.summary: This update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: Part of the APSB26-92 release, this critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows attackers to switch a customer session to another customer account without authentication, administrator privileges, or user interaction, granting access to private customer data.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: This vulnerability in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerabilities in Amasty extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution. Specific CVEs were not immediately available in the provided snippets.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the popular Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension for Magento, which could lead to critical compromise.
